name: tilt-mayhem
description: Sizzle Scramble: an Overcooked-style party game. Phones are the controllers (tilt to walk, real cooking motions), one screen is the kitchen.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @tilt-mayhem/shared" "npm run dev -w @tilt-mayhem/server" "npm run dev -w @tilt-mayhem/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tilt-mayhem/server && npm run build -w @tilt-mayhem/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @tilt-mayhem/server && npm run typecheck -w @tilt-mayhem/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @tilt-mayhem/server
